about: The migration number ledger (APPLY-1). A slice claims its number here, on main, before it writes the file; a file above 0134 whose number is not reserved to a slice fails the migration checks. Status: reserved (claimed, no file yet), landed (the file is on main), released (the number will not be used). A migration PR does not edit this file: a file's presence is what lands a number, so two PRs never touch the same lines. The coordinator appends the next reservation and flips a status in its own commit to main. The monotonic rule (a new file takes a number above every file on its base) is checked against git by `node scripts/ci/apply-plan.mjs --check --base origin/main`.
